subject: Objects
notes: Rule: 'if the identified object is a factory object, the method invocation will resolve to a factory method' (cite.py --check 9.3.6 -> OK §9.3.6 1)). Code: a typed receiver's FACTORY axis picks the roster at bind time (OoBindInstanceInvoke: rdesc.Factory ? cls.FindFactoryMethod : cls.FindMethod, walking INHERITS); a UNIVERSAL receiver dispatches on the runtime object through __CobolInvoke, which EmitCobolInvoke emits separately in the instance type and in the FACTORY singleton type (FOO__FACTORY : BASE__FACTORY), so a universal reference holding a factory object reaches the factory roster. Probe out/probe/objects-p1/p1.cob (pinned cobol.exe, --std 2002/2014/2023): SET U TO OBJC (factory object) then INVOKE U "PING" printed C-FACTORY-PING while the same name through an instance printed A-INSTANCE-PING; INVOKE U "FAONLY" (factory method defined only in grand-base OBJA) found it through the factory chain, and SELF "WHOF" inside it resolved polymorphically to OBJB's factory override (WHOF-B). Golden pb389 (INVOKE F "TAG" through a FACTORY OF reference holding PB389D's factory -> FTAG-D) has spec-derived expected output. || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2002, 2014, 2023 (OO is an ISO/IEC 1989:2002 introduction; absent from 1985 — probe p1.cob at --std 85 is refused COBOL0900)
